list.text: \f[lance]\bLance: \PN!\nIn order to unlock the door to the radio transmitter, you need the voice of a certain person.
\f[lance]\bThe name of the person is Petrel, the Team Rocket Executive!
\f[lance]\bI have found out he is hiding in their leader's office!
\f[lance]\bUnfortunately though, that room is also protected with a password...
\f[lance]\b\PN!\nWe need the password to their leader's office first!
Urrggh... \nThe guy in the cape is incredibly tough...and I had no choice but to tell him all the secrets about this hideout...
Except that our leader's office is protected with two passwords!
\f[facerival]\b...
\f[facerival]\bSo you are messing with them again.
\f[facerival]\bHumph, you must really like Team Rocket so much.
\f[facerival]\b...Tell me, who was the guy in the cape who used Dragon-type Pokémon?
\f[facerival]\bMy Pokémon were no match at all.
\f[facerival]\bI don't care that I lost. I can beat him by getting stronger Pokémon.
\f[facerival]\bIt's what he said that bothers me... He told me that I don't love and trust my Pokémon enough.
\f[facerival]\bI'm furious that I lost to a bleeding heart like him.
\f[facerival]\b...Humph! I don't have the time for the likes of you!
I used to work for Silph, but now I run research for team Rocket.
A meddlesome child like you need to be punished.
A radio signal that drives Pokémon mad... My experiment is a complete success. My promotion is assured.
This loss means absolute nothing.
Do I know the password?
Maybe.
But no weakling's going to get it!

lines: EndSpeech: Tudo bem. Pare. Eu lhe contarei.

list.text: The password to the boss's room is SLOWPOKETAIL.
But it's useless unless you have two passwords.
I don't care that Pokémon are hurt by our experiment.

lines: EndSpeech: Batalhar não é o meu ponto forte.

list.text: If we turn the power of our radio signal for boradcast nationwide...
The very thought excites me!
Hyuck-hyuck-hyuck!
You're challenging me to a battle?\nhah! You're nuts, but you have guts!
I like that! If you can beat me, I'll tell you a password to the boss's room!
The pasword for the boss's door--RATICATETAIL.
But if you don't have both passwords... Ha ha ha!
The door's closed, It needs two passwords to open...
The door's closed...
\PN, entered the two passwords.
The door opened!
Muhahaha, we've been waiting for you. So, you're \PN...
Me?\nYou don't know who I am?
It's me, Giovanni.\nThe majestic Giovanni himself!\nWahahaha!
...Huh?\nI don't sound anything like Giovanni?
I don't even look like Giovanni?\nHow come? I've worked so hard mimic him!
\f[facePetrel]Petrel: I am a Team Rocket Executive!
\f[facePetrel]You must be trying to sneak into the radio-transmitter room.\nWell, that's not going to happen.
\f[facePetrel]That room is protected with a special password. The password "Hail Giovanni."\nSurprised to hear it from me?
\f[facePetrel]Knowing the password won't help you though.
\f[facePetrel]The door won't open unless I say the password. It only reacts to my voice.

lines: EndSpeech: Eu... Nada pude fazer... \n Giovanni, por favor perdoe-me...

then.text: \f[facePetrel]Petrel: Since disbanding Team Rocket three years ago, our Giovanni has been missing.
\f[facePetrel]But we're certain he's been waiting for the right time for our revival...
\f[facePetrel]Losing to you won't change the fact that you are unable to get the radio-transmitter room!
\f[facePetrel]You need my voice to unlock it!
MURKROW is mimicking the voice of Petrel!

list.text: Dragonite: Gyafooha!
MURKROW: Hail Giovanni.
